yaml:
# W3 fixture: uploads an artifact large enough that the controller's
# objStore.Put window is measurable.
#
# W3-6's TOCTOU is bounded by exactly this: handleArtifactUpload checks run
# existence at internal/controller/api_artifacts.go:55 and calls Put at :79
# with nothing in between, and the upload is chunked with no Content-Length
# (internal/agent/client.go:352-360), so the width of the window IS the
# payload transfer time. size_mb is a param so a scenario can widen it without
# a new fixture; the default is the size Task 3 measured.
#
# /dev/urandom, not zeros, on purpose: artifacts are tar+zstd'd, and a
# compressible payload would collapse to a window far shorter than its
# nominal size.
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-artifact-large
spec:
  native: true
  params:
    inputs:
      - name: size_mb
        type: string
        default: "64"
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: make_blob
      run: |
        set -e
        rm -rf big
        mkdir -p big
        head -c $(( {{ .Params.size_mb }} * 1024 * 1024 )) /dev/urandom > big/blob.bin
        ls -l big/blob.bin
        echo "blob-ready {{ .Params.size_mb }}MiB $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)"

    - name: upload_blob
      uploadArtifact:
        name: big-blob
        path: big/blob.bin

    - name: after_upload
      run: echo "upload-returned $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)"
